title: Automated Dental Appointment Coordination
business: A multi-location dental practice managing high volumes of routine check-up scheduling.
problem: Front-desk staff are frequently interrupted by repetitive scheduling inquiries, leading to long hold times and missed patient follow-ups.
solution: By integrating the ElevenLabs connector into Claude, the practice can deploy and refine ElevenAgents directly within the chat interface to handle voice-based appointment scheduling without manual coding or external dashboard switching.
steps: Authenticate the ElevenLabs workspace within the Claude connector settings to enable API access.
Use the agents_create tool to define the agent's persona and scheduling logic based on practice guidelines.
Populate the agent's knowledge base using agents_create_kb_text to include current availability and office policies.
Iterate on the agent's performance by reviewing transcripts and using agents_create_branch to test different conversational flows.
Generate a shareable widget link via the connector to embed the voice agent on the practice website.
outcome: The practice achieves a seamless transition from manual scheduling to automated voice interactions, allowing staff to focus on complex patient care while maintaining consistent, natural-sounding communication.
limitation: The agent relies on the accuracy of the provided knowledge base; users must manually verify the agent's responses against current office schedules, as the connector does not automatically sync with live dental practice management software.
